x: There were 149 starters and the Sheffield lads were soon to the front with Hardy, Holland and Allen filling the first three places. At 4 miles Syd James was 15th, Eric Hall 18th, George Checkley 30th, Hugh McGreechan 36th and Bob Newson 40th.
McMullen, Hyde, Pope, Scammell, Green, Fletcher and Holland were the most prominent. Our 'A' team packed in fine fashion to win the scratch team race (3,6,7,9).
As the race got under way 19 year-old Yitbarek Dinku tagged on to a small leading bunch that included Boxhill's Haywood and Crawley's Holland.
